category_title: Socially withdrawn learners characterized by fear of mockery, isolation, and lack of social initiative
scenario_title: Group work and joint class activities
minimal_context: The student is expected to join a group of peers to perform an assigned task during a lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please get into your groups and start working on the assigned tasks.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits at his desk alone) I didn't want to participate.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to participate in the joint class activities.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: They are all joking, doing something, laughing; I feel ill at ease.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just go over to your group and start a conversation with them.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Nobody associates, nobody talks to you... to start first, no, I can't do that. (Refuses to perform the tasks assigned to the group)
